definitions.explanation: The number 9,000, formed as {九|きゅう} (nine) × {千|せん} (1,000). No sound change occurs, and きゅう is used rather than く.

examples.english: I bought it for nine thousand yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{九千|きゅうせん}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えた→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
examples.english: The number of participants exceeded nine thousand.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{九千|きゅうせん}⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見出|みだ}し{語|ご}→見出し語：24989_midashigo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{収|おさ}められている→収める：02022_osameru⟧。
examples.english: This dictionary contains more than nine thousand headwords.

notes:
Formed as ⟦{九|きゅう}→九：00728_kyuu⟧ × ⟦{千|せん}→千：00809_sen⟧. くせん is not used; きゅう is the standard reading before ⟦{千|せん}→千：00809_sen⟧.

SOUND CHANGES IN THE THOUSANDS:
- ⟦{三千|さんぜん}→三千：00985_sanzen⟧: 3,000 — せん voices to ぜん
- ⟦{八千|はっせん}→八千：30471_hassen⟧: 8,000 — はち shortens to はっ
- ⟦{一千|いっせん}→一千：30472_issen⟧: 1,000 — いち shortens to いっ
- ⟦{四千|よんせん}→四千：30474_yonsen⟧, ⟦{五千|ごせん}→五千：30470_gosen⟧, ⟦{六千|ろくせん}→六千：30475_rokusen⟧, ⟦{七千|ななせん}→七千：30476_nanasen⟧, {九千|きゅうせん}: regular

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {九千|きゅうせん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧: nine thousand yen
- {九千|きゅうせん}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧: nine thousand people
- {九千|きゅうせん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧{台|だい}: in the nine-thousand-yen range
